tracked_diff_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the tracked diff (git status --porcelain output / tracked diff bytes as captured by T003).

description: Per-job test-evidence receipt for P027 BenchReceipt (PROJECT_BOOK v1.2.0 §5.1, §6.2). Frozen by P027-T002; amended by ADR-005 (spec v1.1.0) adding optional git.head_sha_after / git.tree_sha_after; amended by ADR-007 (spec v1.2.0) making verify fail closed when both after fields are absent. No new required fields may be added without a spec change (ADR + SPEC_VERSION bump).

event_name.description: Optional CI event name, e.g. pull_request.

provider.description: github-actions for auto-discovered GitHub Actions metadata; generic for explicitly passed fields on other CI.

run_id.description: Workflow run identifier, kept as a string (GitHub run ids are numeric, e.g. "9001").

workflow.description: Workflow name or file, must match policy expected_workflow.

workflow_sha.description: Optional SHA of the workflow definition commit (PROJECT_BOOK §5.1).

argv_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the canonicalised argv; the full argv is never stored (PROJECT_BOOK §11.1).

display.description: Redacted human-readable command display string; must not contain secrets.

exit_code.description: Process exit code; negative values record signal termination (Python returncode convention).

finished_at.description: Optional capture finish time, UTC ISO 8601 with Z suffix (PROJECT_BOOK §5.1).

dirty_after.description: Tracked worktree dirty at capture end.

dirty_before.description: Tracked worktree dirty at capture start.

expected_source_sha.description: SHA selected by the policy for this source_mode.

head_sha.description: Full lowercase hex of the actually checked-out commit.

head_sha_after.description: Full lowercase hex of HEAD at capture end (after the wrapped command). Added in spec v1.1.0 (ADR-005): when it differs from head_sha the run's tests did not all run against the claimed commit, so verify flags SOURCE_MUTATED_DURING_RUN. Optional so receipts written before v1.1.0 still validate; since spec v1.2.0 (ADR-007) a receipt with BOTH after fields absent is UNBOUND with MISSING_FIELD — it cannot prove the run's HEAD/tree did not change, so it must not BOUND_PASS on the dirty/digest checks alone.

tree_sha_after.description: Full lowercase hex of HEAD^{tree} at capture end. Added in spec v1.1.0 (ADR-005), same rule as head_sha_after: a difference from tree_sha flags SOURCE_MUTATED_DURING_RUN. Since spec v1.2.0 (ADR-007), a receipt with BOTH after fields absent is UNBOUND with MISSING_FIELD (fail closed).

job_id.description: Stable identity of one matrix job, e.g. unit-linux-py312.

junit.description: Optional: absent when the job produced no JUnit report (e.g. LCOV-only jobs). When present, all four counts are required.

additionalProperties.description: Matrix dimension values are JSON scalars only (no nested objects/arrays).

reports.description: May be empty at schema level; an empty list is a verify-time UNBOUND, never a schema pass to BOUND_PASS.

path.description: Relative path inside the evidence bundle only: no leading slash, no '..' segment, no backslash, no trailing slash.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the exact report bytes.

size_bytes.description: Report size in bytes; 1 GiB upper bound (PROJECT_BOOK §11.2 size limits; frozen value, see ADR-001).

source_state_after.description: Optional: tracked-diff snapshot at capture end (PROJECT_BOOK §5.5).

source_state_before.description: Optional: tracked-diff snapshot at capture start (PROJECT_BOOK §5.5). Capture SHOULD always emit it; the schema tolerates absence so hand-written fixtures validate.

started_at.description: Optional capture start time, UTC ISO 8601 with Z suffix (PROJECT_BOOK §5.1).
